cases.study_information: Predict the antibody concentration inhibiting VEGF-driven proliferation of primary human umbilical-vein endothelial cells. HUVECs undergo5h serum starvation, then0.125nM humanVEGF-A165 stimulation,48h incubation and CCK-8 readout after3h. Visible reporter results come from VEGFR2-NFAT-RE-luc2 HEK293 cells exposed to0.125nM VEGF for6h; the Emaxcolumn is normalized to the reference in that reporter experiment. These readouts are not interchangeable. AK112 retains its observed HUVECIC50; new construct values are withheld. Reported ties reflect source precision and are preserved.

dependence_note: Shared sources must be interpreted at the study-family level.
title: Transferring VEGFR2 reporter inhibition to primary endothelial proliferation
